verification: Aggregate latest outcomes from broad regression and focused reruns; raw runs and their source hashes are retained. Final build changes to action-message visibility and Upgrade flashing were verified by targeted reruns.
notes: Six broad-run assertions were updated for V27 name capitalization and passed on rerun.

Focused failures exposed a hidden payout instruction, an invalid zero-points fixture, and a cloud policy blocking file URLs. The visibility bug and fixture were fixed; offline dungeon play was verified with networking disabled.
Direct file:// navigation returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. No direct-file launch or physical Safari verification is claimed.
Build, JavaScript syntax, both data templates, deterministic rebuild and git diff --check passed.
